headline: Forget Quiet Luxury. In Ancient Rome, the Fashion Was Loud.
context: An exhibition in Copenhagen reveals how imperial expansion delivered the vivid dyes, exotic fabrics and real-hair wigs that Romans used to broadcast their status.
